metadata.subject: Maths

layout.page1: intro (header, method, common mistakes, worked example, visual aid)
layout.writingSpace: none — pupils work in separate workbooks

metadata.note: Base canonical version. No SEND overlay applied.

intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
methodSteps: 1  Three parts — work on all of them
3  Undo ×/÷ across all three (flip both if ÷ negative)
4  Write as one statement a < x ≤ b
5  List integers / draw the line if asked
commonMistakes: Only doing the step to two of the three parts.
Not reversing both signs when ÷ by a negative.
Mixing up which end is included.
workedExample: Subtract 3 from all parts: −2 < 2x ≤ 6. Divide all by 2: −1 < x ≤ 3.
intro.visualAid: A double inequality like −1 < x ≤ 3 is a section of the number line: open circle at −1 (not included), filled circle at 3 (included), with the part between them shaded.

questions.content: List the integers: a) −2 < x ≤ 3  b) 0 ≤ x < 4  c) −3 ≤ x ≤ 1
Solve (reverse the signs): a) 1 ≤ 5 − x < 4  b) −2 < 3 − x ≤ 2
Solve 4 ≤ 2x − 6 < 10. a) Single inequality. b) List integers. c) Show on a number line.
a) Length L = 50 cm to nearest 10 cm — write the error interval. b) Solve 3 ≤ (y+1) ÷ 2 < 6 and list integer y.
